items.q: So, it was the Tonight -- the Johnny Carson -- the Tonight Show. They said that we was to do that extra show anyhow in the (unintelligible) House, and they would give us a shot on the Tonight Show.

ctx.x: By that time we had to move out of there, see. Now, from performing in the Apollo Theater, we had to pinch hit, do an extra show for Mr. James Brown, you know. What they call him? He sang so he had to have these -- this great -- some kind of music. He was doing studious music, I call it, because -- poor boy made good, other words, right?

So, it was the Tonight -- the Johnny Carson -- the Tonight Show. They said that we was to do that extra show anyhow in the (unintelligible) House, and they would give us a shot on the Tonight Show. They said they couldn't employ the whole amount, but some of them tap dance.

So, we wanted the buck to be the buck, so we accepted. And then it's all beginning to happen, and it's starting out. So, there we come. We got this chance to go down and get orchestrations, and new costumes, and to premier, you know, and then be contracted, you see.
